# All tools

<p>Every one of the seven mapped tools, merged into a single profile: what the tools cover <i>together</i>, and — more to the point — what none of them covers.</p>

<p>Merged with <code>merge-profiles</code> from the individual mappings of <a href="{{ '/evaluation/lopes2023/mono2micro/' | relative_url }}">Mono2Micro</a>, <a href="{{ '/evaluation/wang2024/mono2micro_ibm/' | relative_url }}">Mono2Micro (IBM)</a>, <a href="{{ '/evaluation/zhong2025/micro2micro/' | relative_url }}">Micro2Micro</a>, <a href="{{ '/evaluation/wang2024/cargo/' | relative_url }}">CARGO</a>, <a href="{{ '/evaluation/wang2024/hydec/' | relative_url }}">HyDec</a>, <a href="{{ '/evaluation/wang2024/mem/' | relative_url }}">MEM</a>, <a href="{{ '/evaluation/wang2024/mosaic/' | relative_url }}">MOSAIC</a>.</p>

## Proposed model extension

The union of every feature the tools exposed that the model did not have, added to a copy of the model. A proposal by the authors, not skill output.
